newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales reductions of 142,000 metric tons (MT) were primarily the result of increases for Venezuela (40,400 MT) and Jamaica (15,500 MT) being more than offset by changing to the 1997/98 marketing year for Iraq (50,000 MT), Japan (41,000 MT), Yemen (40,000 MT), Egypt (35,000 MT), Ecuador (31,200 MT, including 29,500 MT switched to 97/98 and decreases of 1,700 MT).

Net sales for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year (which begins June 1) totaled 1,070,800 MT, with Egypt (566,500 MT), the Philippines (107,500 MT), Israel (86,500 MT), Japan (70,000 MT), Iraq (50,000 MT), unknown destinations (41,500 MT), and Yemen (40,000 MT) being the major buyers.

Exports of 188,200 MT were off 36 percent from the week earlier and 42 percent from the 4-week average. The primary recipients were Taiwan (35,300 MT), Venezuela (25,200 MT), South Korea (23,200 MT), North Korea (22,000 MT), and Ecuador (19,800 MT).
